title: Improving Model Evaluation using SMART Filtering of Benchmark Datasets
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of world religions, as a sub-category within the MMLU benchmark.
findings: Within the MMLU dataset, 59.06% of the examples from the 'World Religions' category were removed by the SMART filtering process. This suggests that a significant portion of the questions related to world religions were identified as being easy, data-contaminated, or redundant.
